Hi Elena / Finance team,

Thanks again for the productive renewal conversation earlier this week. We’ve drafted the minimal amendment for the renewal + capacity top-up you requested. Two billing items we need to confirm so we can send a final DocuSign bundle and get the PO(s) issued:

Do you want a single consolidated PO that lists both remit-to entities (one invoice per month split by percentage), or two separate POs (one per legal entity)?

2) Net terms & invoice recipient: can you confirm desired net terms (Net30 / Net45) and the primary invoice recipient email for each legal entity? Also confirm whether invoices should be routed to AP (finance@oriontech.com) or to the program owner (elena.santos@oriontech.com) for approval.

Attached: Redwood_Commitment_Amendment_v1.pdf (redlined draft) to review. I’ve included a proposed invoice cadence (monthly) and a suggested split for the first 90 days in the doc.

If you prefer two POs, we’ll supply separate remittance instructions and invoice templates. If a single PO is easier, we can issue monthly invoices with an itemized split line per entity. Both are workable — just want to align on what finance needs for processing and audit.

Jonas, looping you in for any constraints on issuing invoices across two remit entities for this deal. Marissa — I’ll need your guidance on the practical steps (W‑9s, EIN mapping, and invoice headers).

Thanks,
